affine_only_cut_barrier.statement: After quotienting symmetry, Z_00=1 and Z_ii=Z_0i, Boolean degree-2 moment points affinely span the full reduced moment space.
affine_only_cut_barrier.consequence: No nontrivial universal same-coordinate affine linear cut can separate all spurious moment points while preserving every Boolean rank-one point.
affine_only_cut_barrier.scope: Does not block instance-specific affine consequences, nonlinear cuts, new auxiliary representations, or certified recursive quotient/fibre schemes.

next_gate.question: Can the polynomial nonlinear anchored-minor basis be absorbed by an exact polynomial solver or a certified polynomially bounded recursion without selector/fibre enumeration?

anti_loop: Do not call Horn+affine tractable merely because each minor has a compact Horn encoding.
Do not replace product identities by guessed selector variables.
Do not use input-dependent recursion without an independent polynomial potential.
Do not promote a polynomial separation oracle into a polynomial decision algorithm.
